name: Paper 3 - Regime A - HDPE/BaWO4 phi=0.189 (60.0 wt%)
description: Regime-A (effective-medium) benchmark: HDPE/BaWO4 at volume fraction phi=0.189. Gives 60.0 wt% BaWO4 / 40.0 wt% HDPE at rho_eff=1.927 g/cm3 (linear mixture rule: rho_f=6.12, rho_m=0.95). DUAL K-edges: Ba at 37.441 keV (straddles 30–50 keV) and W at 69.525 keV (straddles 50–80 keV). This provides simultaneous multi-edge coverage unique among the study materials.

paper3.notes: New fourth-material in paper-3 multi-material campaign. φ=0.189, same energy grid as other materials. Dual K-edge material: Ba K-edge 37.441 keV + W K-edge 69.525 keV. random_seed=13579.
